# Ahmet Can Yesildag

> Global hospitality leader with 30+ years of experience across five continents. Founder and principal of Greenmountains Trade Ltd. (CBCA #1373422-6, Oakville, Ontario) — delivering executive advisory through Greenmountains · Executive Consultancy, including a current North American Business Development advisory engagement with Heyhotel AI. Cornell University Hotel School alumnus (General Managers Program, Class of 2015), Past President of Skål International Baku Chapter (2013–2017), CHA-certified hospitality executive, and principal of Orophile · Wellness Journeys — a fee-based advisory practice using landscape as method.
